# Reports

Reports give Organisation Admins a consolidated view of financial activity across all order channels. Access Reports from the **Management** menu on the Dashboard.

## Accessing Reports

From the Dashboard, open the management dropdown (gear icon) and select **Reports**. This option is only visible to Organisation Admins and Super Admins.

## Filtering

All reports share two global filters at the top of the page:

### Date Range
Choose from preset ranges or define a custom period:
- **Current Week** / **Last Week**
- **Current Month** / **Last Month**
- **Last 30 Days** / **Last 90 Days**
- **Custom** — pick specific start and end dates

### Order Channel
Filter results by how the order was placed:
- **All Channels** — includes everything
- **POS** — orders from Square, Shopify, or Lightspeed
- **Manual** — orders created directly in OrderHub
- **Pixfizz** — orders originating from Pixfizz websites

Cancelled orders are automatically excluded from all reports.

## Report Types

### Tax Summary
A daily breakdown of sales split into taxable and tax-exempt totals.

| Column | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| Date | The calendar day |
| Channel | Order channel (POS, Manual, Pixfizz) |
| Taxable Sales | Total sales where tax was charged |
| Tax Collected | The tax amount collected |
| Tax-Exempt Sales | Total sales with no tax applied |

Use this report for tax filing and reconciliation.

### Sales by Process
Shows revenue and units sold grouped by **Process** (e.g. Canvas Wraps, Enlargements, Metal Prints, Scanning) and aggregated by month.

| Column | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| Process | The process name (resolved from job categories) |
| Month | The calendar month |
| Channel | Order channel |
| Units Sold | Total quantity of items |
| Total Sales | Revenue for that process |

This report helps identify which products and services drive the most revenue over time.

### Sales by Payment Method
A daily breakdown of sales grouped by how customers paid.

| Column | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| Date | The calendar day |
| Payment Method | e.g. cash, card, invoice, etc. |
| Channel | Order channel |
| Order Count | Number of orders |
| Total Sales | Total revenue |

Use this to reconcile daily takings against payment processor records.

## Exporting Data

Each report provides two export options:

- **Export CSV** — downloads a `.csv` file containing all rows plus a totals row, ready for import into spreadsheet software
- **Print / PDF** — opens the browser print dialog with a clean, print-friendly layout; select "Save as PDF" to generate a PDF file

## Summary Totals

Every report includes a **totals row** at the bottom of the table showing aggregate figures for the selected date range and channel filter.
